instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out whether a person joins a shared space by the way its join rows allow (free, or holding the access a row names) and answer their member row", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them); records (The records the ask reads, as the caller read them from a store ({ id, type, value }): the space's record:space row, the member rows of the space (record:space-member), and, when a join row asks for access, the payment-event, record:commercial-offer, access-grant, access-effect-rule and effect-lifecycle rows.).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:join-a-space and its input (the worked example shows one).
